versions.changelog:
Initial release of code-debug-companion:

- Provides an AI-driven workflow for automatic code error diagnosis, solution research, code fixing, and validation.
- Supports error handling via pasted messages, screenshots, or full error stacks.
- Integrates code review, web search, unit test generation, and GitHub issue tracking skills.
- Outputs concise diagnosis, related discussions, fix details, test coverage, and affected files.
- Supports multiple programming languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C++.
